First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x-2y+4z=6 \\ 0x+y-9z=-2 \\ x-y-8z=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -9 \\ 1 & -1 & -8\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -9 \\ 1 & -1 & -8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$
